data.description:
## Context / Problem
On current `origin/main`, `infra/terraform-github/versions.tf` describes the Terraform provider path as equivalent to the shell fallback. They intentionally differ: `terraform-github/main.tf` locks only `main` so release tags remain available, while `apply-mirror-lock.sh` locks `main` and all tags. The comment hides a security/operations tradeoff.

## Approach
Replace the parity claim with a concise statement of the intentional tag-protection difference and point to the authoritative implementations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The comment accurately distinguishes main-only Terraform locking from shell main-and-tag locking.
- [ ] No Terraform value or executable behavior changes.
- [ ] Terraform format/validate and `make lint` pass.
data.title: Correct terraform-github fallback parity comment for tag protection
